activation_gates: Confirm source branches and app manifests are present.
Run a local build/preview of the complete 46-theme registry without changing production.
Test all current routes plus /architecture/ and /gallery/ in the preview.
Check navigation, mobile layout, accessible search, link rewrites and content-provenance treatment.
Review the version drift and build fallbacks before changing the production registry.
Only then update themes.json to 1.2.0 and run post-deploy route checks.
